# AL1004: Use SequenceEqual when comparing Span with non-constants

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

## Description

When comparing Span and a non-constant, use SequenceEqual instead of equality operators, unless you want to compare addresses.
